canonical_project: Aruba Global Cloud Data Center IT3, Ponte San Pietro (Bergamo)
notes: Aruba's flagship 200,000 m2 campus in Ponte San Pietro (BG), 'largest data center campus in Italy': buildings DC-A, DC-B, DC-C (DC-B/DC-C inaugurated Dec 2022 with on-site PV), Tier IV design, 60 MW power per directory. Aruba acquired two hydroelectric plants in Bergamo province (2023) to power the campus. Capacity figure is directory/operator-stated total campus power.
